profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am an inquisitive, energetic, problem-solver with a strong foundation in programming logic, data structure, math, and strong coding. My solid development skills combined with my collaborative and communication skills, passion and creativity, position me well to develop new and enhanced system functionality including custom code and packaged application configuration for Teleios unique platform which helps our stakeholders add value and manage their business.

I graduated from Texas Southern University in May 2019 with a double major in Computer Science and Mathematics.

Areas of Expertise: Mobile Application, Software Development, Web Development, Database Knowledge, Machine Learning, OpenCV, PLC Programming, GitHub, Data Structure, Cryptography, Computer Networking

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Our team can design any kind of software application from a WordPress site to an enterprise-level application hosted using cloud technology like AWS. Our main focus is to design custom software solutions for our clients and make their tasks automated by designing great software with a dashing dashboard and many more components with features like graphs, tables, import/export data, and more.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
As a Developer at Teleios Commodities my primary focus is on developing user interface applications to gather, listen and interpret market data to assist in Teleios’s and our customers decision-making processes. My role is to provide the technology that can add immediate analytical horsepower to the build, buy or partner question faced by our customers.

I am currently developing a user-interface application using the frontend React framework, combined with Bootstrap and MaterialUI, a responsive (mobile-first) framework with robust features and built-in utilities. The interface will have several components such as login, dashboard, income, and more pages where the client will be able to view their portfolio valuation and other more details. 

The application will use many third-party libraries such as react-table and react-charts where data will be displayed in table format with attached graph to see the visualization of available data. Also, in many cases the data will be viewed by yearly or monthly format using the drop-down selection option. 

The application will use MaterialUI and React Bootstrap framework to make the user interface more robust and user friendly with different browser and devices. 

Combining Teleios’s superior level of subject matter expertise with this type of analytical tool plays a major role in answering the question of economic feasibility of any project we consider.

positions.title: Software/Web Developer
positions.description:
As the Software/Web Developer for YAADADA I have developed a robust online e-commerce store running on Shopify and integrated to Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel to analyze real-time user activity.

In addition to maintaining the e-commerce website, I am currently developing a react-native cross-platform mobile app for YAADADA.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: As an Undergraduate Research Assistant, I was involved in two projects: Security analysis of AES attack and its vulnerability on the wireless sensor network, and, a Computer Vision application that determines different food calories by capturing an image using camera and survey grading program which can record the data as far as user fill/mark a circle.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
I redesigned a website for a professor which included additional information and features.

Initiated and began designing a computer program to recognize food. Additionally, I developed computer program using C# and EmguCV to recognize food.

Designed and developed computer program to recognize marked survey paper with a feature that determines if it’s a half / full filled marked.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was selected as a Position of Vice-Captain in middle school ( Ambe Vidyalaya ) for one year through electoral college, where approximately more than 6000 students vote. Furthermore, our team creates several activity to encourage student like Annual Concert, Sports Meet, Republic Day, Independence Day and educational activity like General knowledge Quiz, Elocution Competition, Essay Competition, Puzzle Game. Consequently, as our daily duty, we used to ask two quiz question to students, speak headlines news (city, state, national, and international).

Due to my good performance in last position (Vice-Captain), I was again nominated for the position of Captain in High School ( Ambe Vidyalaya ) for one year through electoral college, where more than six thousand students vote. Furthermore, our team creates several activities to encourage students like Annual Concert, Sports Meet, Republic Day, Independence Day and educational activity like General knowledge Quiz, Elocution Competition, Essay Competition, Puzzle Game. Additionally, during this term we add one more festival to our list name Kite Flying (Uttrayan).Consequently, as our daily duty we used to ask two quiz question to students, speak headlines news (city, state, national, and international).

projects.title: Black Jack Game
projects.description:
Black Jack game using C++.
- Ask user to insert the money from $5 to $100; if the amount is not in range then reject it and ask them to insert again.
- each user and bet 5 time.
- user can cash the money if the point is inbetween 17 to 21.
- if the point is 21 for both user and dealer then they win and if user win they get double money.
- if the point is more then 21 then who so ever has it they are busted and game is over.
- and much more features.
